memo: E2 product-order study (CPU, no submit, 244 fold0 NPs, class-3 simulation). e2par-2 found: from the spectral-analog parents MMP generates the truth for 35.8% of molecules, but only 20.9% reach the candidate list -> the 60-product cut (parent sim x log rule count) drops ~15 points; FP-retrieved parents add nothing (dropped: mmpfp=0). Here all valid products (<=3000) are scored and the truth's rank is logged under 3 orders: count (old), fp (log-likelihood of the product's bits under the predicted FP), mix (rank sum); the kept 60 use mix. Pass: truth kept within 60 well above 0.209 and C3VAL MRR@25 above 0.230.
